name: Aldric Voss
source_profile:
Marquis Aldric “Old Iron” Voss 
The Iron Baron, as the prospectors call him, is a stern former 
military commander whose loyalty during the civil war earned 
him his new title. His family has old northern roots, but little 
remaining wealth. He sees the frontier's mines as a way to 
restore his house's fortunes. 
Marquisate of Thornhollow 
The timber marquisate seated at the town of Thornhollow. The 
region is referred to as the Thornwood by loggers and rangers.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 16–16 (source excerpt)
